meta.model: KD_ad ~ Poisson(E_ad p_ad); log p_ad = log L730(t) + const + division + 5-round + title + f(defender) + g(attacker) + log u_d + log v_a; E = standing head strikes landed by a (midpoint of the ufcstats bounds); u, v = Gamma(alpha, alpha) fighter chin / power effects with walk-forward posterior means (alpha + KD) / (alpha + expected KD) over earlier fights
meta.exposure: standing head landed = (max(HEAD - GROUND, 0) + min(HEAD, DISTANCE + CLINCH)) / 2 per fight

ladder_test.model: M0 constant KD per standing head strike
E1 M1 + fighter chin effect only
E2 M1 + fighter power effect only
E3 M1 + chin and power effects
F  final: M3 + chin and power effects
F+body final + height, ape index, reach advantage

models.model: K4 composite: predicted KD rate + exposure + Elo
K5 direct: K3 + age, damage, layoff, fighter effects
K7 K4 + direct damage and move terms
